hooks.text: Cafe ka WhatsApp raat 11 baje baja, reply subah tak nahi...?
Main iske baare mein galat tha...
Customer WhatsApp ka reply der se milta hai, turant competitor ko chala jata hai.

beats.line: Cafe ka WhatsApp raat 11 baje baja, reply subah tak nahi...?
beats.visual: Owner checking phone, sees no reply, looks worried as another cafe's ad appears

beats.line: Maine ek local gym ko WhatsApp par message kiya, 23 Nov tak reply nahi aaya.
beats.visual: Screenshot of WhatsApp chat with 'delivered' tick, no response

beats.line: Kya sirf WhatsApp hi aapka sabse bada blocker hai?
beats.visual: Close-up of WhatsApp icon with a question mark overlay

beats.line: Main aapke liye mobile‑first website banata hoon, usmein WhatsApp click‑to‑chat aur tap‑to‑call button lagata hoon, taaki enquiry ek tap mein mil jaye.
beats.visual: Phone screen showing the website layout with a WhatsApp click‑to‑chat button and a tap‑to‑call icon

beats.line: Astra Labs ke hisaab se 61.6% sites mein contact form nahi, matlab aadha enquiry miss hota hai.
beats.visual: Bar chart from Astra Labs report highlighting 61.6% figure

beats.line: Comment SITE, main DM mein checklist bhejunga. Poora breakdown aaj ke carousel mein hai.
beats.visual: Text overlay with 'Comment SITE' and a DM envelope icon

master_script.cta: Comment SITE, main DM mein checklist bhejunga. Poora breakdown aaj ke carousel mein hai.
master_script.linkedin_english: If your WhatsApp replies are delayed, customers switch to competitors. A simple mobile‑first website with click‑to‑chat and tap‑to‑call buttons ensures instant enquiries. 61.6% of sites lack a contact form, meaning half of potential leads are missed. Comment SITE to receive a checklist in DM.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: 10 things a customer judges your website on, with an honest note on whether you need a new one

facts.claim: A WhatsApp number does not appear in Google search results, so without a website new customers cannot find you
facts.title: Why Your Business Needs a Website, Not Just WhatsApp

facts.claim: WhatsApp cannot show a full catalogue; owners must send individual photos or PDFs that load slowly, preventing customers from browsing at their own pace
facts.title: Why Your Business Needs a Website, Not Just WhatsApp

facts.claim: A weak or missing call-to-action on a website, such as lacking a "WhatsApp Us Now" button, converts significantly worse than a pre-filled WhatsApp click-to-chat message
facts.title: 10 Website Mistakes Costing Indian Small Businesses Leads in 2026

facts.claim: 61.6% of homepages had no contact form
facts.title: State of Small Business Websites 2026: Data from 1,568 Businesses Astra Labs

facts.claim: 54.8% of homepages had no tap-to-call link
facts.title: State of Small Business Websites 2026: Data from 1,568 Businesses Astra Labs

facts.claim: 52.2% of homepages lacked any one-tap call or message option, with WhatsApp links being rare
facts.title: State of Small Business Websites 2026: Data from 1,568 Businesses Astra Labs

facts.claim: Corporate clients often request a website link as a trust signal; a WhatsApp number alone looks informal and can miss professional credibility
facts.title: Why Your Business Needs a Website, Not Just WhatsApp
